mkl-uml-domain-modeler.description_zh: 从业务描述、需求和用户故事创建、审查或重构 PlantUML 概念领域模型，明确领域术语、属性、关联及多重性。适用于实现设计前的领域分析；附带 Python 校验脚本，图形渲染需另备 PlantUML。
mkl-uml-domain-modeler.description_en: Create, review, or refactor conceptual UML domain models in PlantUML from business requirements. Clarify concepts, attributes, relationships, and multiplicities before implementation design. Python validation scripts are included; diagram rendering requires PlantUML separately.
examples_zh: 根据以下订单业务需求建立概念领域模型，输出 PlantUML，并列出需要确认的多重性。
审查这份领域模型中的组合、继承和关联是否符合业务语义，区分领域概念与实现类。
重构这份领域模型，保留现有追踪标识，并使用附带脚本校验。
examples_en: Create a conceptual domain model in PlantUML from these order requirements and identify uncertain multiplicities.
Review composition, inheritance, and associations in this domain model against the business rules.
Refactor this domain model while preserving traceability identifiers, then run the bundled validator.

mkl-uml-use-case-diagram.description_zh: 从系统范围和用户目标创建、审查或重构 PlantUML 用例图，识别系统边界、参与者及用例，检查 include、extend 和泛化关系。适用于需求分析与目标范围梳理；附带 Python 校验脚本，图形渲染需另备 PlantUML。
mkl-uml-use-case-diagram.description_en: Create, review, or refactor UML use case diagrams in PlantUML. Identify system boundaries, actors, goals, and justified include, extend, or generalization relationships. Python validation scripts are included; rendering requires PlantUML separately.
examples_zh: 根据这份系统需求画出用例图，明确系统边界、主要参与者和支持参与者。
检查这份用例图中的 include 和 extend 方向、条件及使用理由。
整理这份用例图，保留已有 CU 标识，并运行附带的校验脚本。
examples_en: Create a use case diagram from these requirements with an explicit system boundary and participating actors.
Review the directions, conditions, and justification of include and extend relationships in this diagram.
Refactor this use case diagram while retaining existing CU identifiers and run the bundled validator.

mkl-use-case-specifier.description_zh: 将业务目标、需求讨论或用例草稿整理为 Markdown 用例规格，编写参与者与系统交互、基本流程、替代流程、异常流程及验收条件，维护与图表和测试的追踪关系。适用于需求细化与规格审查；附带 Python 结构校验脚本。
mkl-use-case-specifier.description_en: Write, complete, review, or refactor textual use case specifications in Markdown. Define actor/system interactions, basic, alternative, and exception flows, acceptance criteria, and traceability to diagrams and tests. Python structural validation is included.
examples_zh: 把这段需求讨论整理为下单用例规格，写出基本流程、异常流程和成功后置条件。
审查这份用例规格中的前置条件、分支触发条件和流程恢复点，指出缺失证据。
补全这份 Markdown 用例规格，保留 CU、FA、FE 标识，并运行附带校验脚本。
examples_en: Turn this requirements discussion into an order use case specification with basic and exception flows.
Review the preconditions, branch triggers, and flow resumption points in this specification.
Complete this Markdown specification while preserving CU, FA, and FE identifiers, then run the bundled validator.

mkl-uml-robustness-diagram.description_zh: 根据用例行为创建、审查或重构 PlantUML 鲁棒分析图，划分边界、控制和实体责任，检查流程覆盖与领域概念闭合。适用于详细设计前的分析设计；附带 Python BCE 规则校验脚本，图形渲染需另备 PlantUML。
mkl-uml-robustness-diagram.description_en: Create, review, or refactor boundary/control/entity robustness diagrams in PlantUML. Map use case behavior to responsibilities, check flow coverage, and identify missing domain concepts before detailed design. Python BCE profile validation is included; rendering requires PlantUML separately.
examples_zh: 根据这份下单用例规格建立鲁棒分析图，标出边界、控制和实体。
审查这份鲁棒分析图是否覆盖基本、替代和异常流程，并核对实体与领域模型的对应关系。
重构这份 API 用例鲁棒分析图，保留 CU 和 DR 标识，并运行附带的 BCE 校验脚本。
examples_en: Build a robustness diagram from this order use case specification with boundary, control, and entity responsibilities.
Review basic, alternative, and exception flow coverage and map entities to the supplied domain model.
Refactor this API use case robustness diagram while retaining CU and DR identifiers, then run the BCE validator.
